name: The Horde Needs More Thick Leather!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs More Thick Leather!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did it, friend, I knew that you would! Once again, thank you on behalf of the entire Horde. Your efforts have been noted and are greatly appreciated. And if you find yourself with more thick leather that you'd like to donate, bring them to me here.
